q1_issues.issue: 'one of the world's largest producers of softwood' is encoded as the comparison-class (Degree weyerhaeuser large (forKind producer)) — large relative to the producer norm — instead of the licensed top-stratum (AmongMost large weyerhaeuser producer), dropping the superlative and asserting a different claim.
the stated domain restriction 'the world's' is left unencoded, though the AmongMost rule requires a stated domain restriction to remain on the entity as its own atoms.
the Measure scale 'quantity' is invented — no word supplies the dimension, so the reserved slot symbol 'unspecified' is required.

q2_gaps: a measure NP serving as a verb's direct object ('can produce about 7.6 billion board feet a year') — the instruction set defines Measure for entities, event duration and scalar-change deltas, but does not say how an output-amount object attaches or what fills its scale slot
notes: Correctly handled: the nominalization's of-argument as the entity-attached oblique (Of weyerhaeuser softwood), no (can produce) capability atom because 'producer' is only an appositive here, the bare typing atom (present-modal host clause needs no wrapper), and the tight-hedge distribution ParticleFromNormal 7600000000 760000000 at 10 percent sigma. No object is invented for the produce event, which matches the text.
